projects.title: A Budgeted Coding-Agent Harness
projects.description: An independent Python harness with observable tools, restart recovery, context policies, and a controlled empirical study. The portfolio combines an inspectable implementation with evidence about how bounded recent history compares with evidence-preserving compaction.
requirements: A raw loop with explicit terminal states, validated tools, enforced limits, and deterministic fake-model tests.
Controlled disposable execution, permission checks, failure injection, append-only events, and supported resume reconciliation.
A 24-task private suite: eight development tasks and sixteen final tasks, with reference/no-op/broken grader controls.
A frozen 16 × 2 × 3 = 96-attempt study comparing context policies with one pinned model, matched tools/budgets, inclusive overhead, and every failure retained.
An MCP adapter and direct/protocol parity tests preserving host authorization.
A technical report with paired per-task outcomes, honest uncertainty, cost tables, reproducible commands, and a success/restart/bounded-failure demo.
A clean-checkout verification path, evidence index, and minimal external contribution draft or verified compatibility finding.
